about_the_game:
"Previous Basicset" is the default asset pack that was bundled with RPG Developer Bakin up to version 1.15.
Starting from version 1.16, the standard Basicset has been updated automatically through software updates and includes a renewed set of assets.

This pack is intended for creators who wish to continue using or reference the original default assets provided in earlier versions of Bakin.
